prompt_messages.content: /no_think You are a planner. Reply with ONLY a JSON object (no markdown, no prose, no thinking). Use EXACTLY these field names: id, goal_id, version, tasks, dependencies, branches. Each task uses: id, description, action, target, risk_class, optional rollback{trigger,action,safety_guard}, optional verification{what,how,expected}, optional preconditions (array of {description, fact, established_by}), optional parallel_group, optional blast_radius. preconditions MUST be objects with description, fact, established_by fields — NEVER strings. established_by MUST be the id of an earlier task in the plan that establishes the fact, or 'env' if it is an environment fact (not a task output). Do NOT use fact names or descriptions as established_by — use the task id. Each dependency uses: from_task, to_task, kind, optional reason. Each branch uses: id, kind, tasks, join. High/critical risk tasks MUST have rollback AND verification. All tasks with risk_class high or critical MUST include both rollback and verification objects. Example shape: {"id":"plan-x","goal_id":"g","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"backup","description":"Back up the database","action":"backup","target":"db","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"db is reachable","fact":"db_healthy","established_by":"env"}]},{"id":"migrate","description":"Apply schema migration","action":"migrate","target":"schema","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"migration fails","action":"restore from backup","safety_guard":"verify backup integrity"},"verification":{"what":"schema version","how":"run checks","expected":"v2"}}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"backup","to_task":"migrate","kind":"hard"}]}

response_content: {"id":"inf-04-workload-identity-plan","goal_id":"inf-04-workload-identity","version":1,"tasks":[{"id":"create_service_account","description":"Create a new service account in GCP for workload identity","action":"create","target":"service_account","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"creation fails","action":"notify admin","safety_guard":"verify service account permissions"},"verification":{"what":"service account existence","how":"check gcloud for service account","expected":"service account created successfully"}},{"id":"migrate_pods","description":"Migrate existing pods to use the new service account","action":"migrate","target":"pods","risk_class":"critical","rollback":{"trigger":"migration fails","action":"revert pods to old service account","safety_guard":"verify old service account is intact"},"verification":{"what":"pod service account","how":"describe pods and check service account","expected":"pods using new service account"}},{"id":"verify_changes","description":"Verify that all pods are functioning correctly with the new service account","action":"verify","target":"pods","risk_class":"high","rollback":{"trigger":"verification fails","action":"restore previous configuration","safety_guard":"ensure all previous settings are saved before changes"},"verification":{"what":"pod functionality","how":"test important endpoints","expected":"all pods respond appropriately"}},{"id":"remove_old_credentials","description":"Remove old workload identity credentials and service account","action":"delete","target":"old_credentials","risk_class":"medium","preconditions":[{"description":"no pods are using old credentials","fact":"pods_verification_complete","established_by":"verify_changes"}]}],"dependencies":[{"from_task":"create_service_account","to_task":"migrate_pods","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"migrate_pods","to_task":"verify_changes","kind":"hard"},{"from_task":"verify_changes","to_task":"remove_old_credentials","kind":"hard"}],"branches":[] }
